title: Test Kitchen Smoky Chicken
summary: A private build fixture used to verify every part of the recipe page before the first real meal is published.
sourceNote: Build fixture — excluded from the production site.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss 1½ lb chicken with 1 tablespoon smoked paprika, ½ teaspoon kosher salt, and 1 tablespoon olive oil.
Spread the chicken on a sheet pan and roast for 18 minutes.
Check that the thickest piece reaches 165°F, then rest for 5 minutes before serving.
